claim: Team turnover is a six-month, aggregate manager-team exposure rate. A team contains active regular direct reports sharing manager_employee_id; it excludes the manager and peers. Each exit is attributed to the last active-regular manager snapshot on or before term_date.

scenarios.label: All manager-led teams
scenarios.eligibility: At least 1 direct report at the 2026-08-23 cutoff

scenarios.label: Teams with >5 direct reports
scenarios.eligibility: At least 6 direct reports at the 2026-08-23 cutoff

acceptance_rule: Six monthly snapshots must occur in the window; each scenario must have at least 30 manager teams; every displayed team must have direct-report exposure; and only exits with a pre-exit manager assignment can enter the rate.
limitations: The measure is descriptive and aggregate-only; it is not a manager label or causal claim.
Voluntary Exception is excluded pending authoritative HR treatment.
No shrinkage, comparable-population adjustment, or minimum historical exposure rule is applied to the all-team scenario.
